description: This line plot illustrates the number of shared experts for two samples as a function of sample token count, with the x-axis labeled “Sample Token Count” and using a logarithmic scale with tick marks at powers of two ranging from 2^9 to 2^20, and the y-axis labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples” with a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 6.0. Six distinct lines represent different task categories: Intent (orange, solid line with square markers), Summary (blue, solid line with square markers), Law (yellow, solid line with square markers), Translation (purple, solid line with square markers), Code (gray, solid line with square markers), and Math (green, solid line with square markers). The Intent line starts at approximately 3.7 at 2^9 and rises to about 6.0 at 2^20, with a dip to around 3.9 at 2^12. The Summary line begins at 2.0 at 2^9, rises sharply to about 4.7 at 2^12, then declines slightly to around 4.5 at 2^14 before rising again to approximately 5.8 at 2^20. The Law line starts at 3.6 at 2^9, increases to a peak of about 5.7 at 2^13, then declines to around 5.5 at 2^14 before rising again to approximately 6.0 at 2^20. The Translation line begins at 5.1 at 2^9, rises to a peak of about 5.7 at 2^13, then declines slightly to around 5.5 at 2^14 before rising again to approximately 6.0 at 2^20. The Code line starts at 2.0 at 2^9, rises to a peak of about 3.7 at 2^13, then declines to around 3.1 at 2^14 before rising again to approximately 5.7 at 2^20. The Math line begins at 3.7 at 2^9, rises to a peak of about 5.7 at 2^13, then declines slightly to around 5.5 at 2^14 before rising again to approximately 6.0 at 2^20.
